title: Current Copilot-edited tree: CORE, correctness and code-quality audit

reviewer.name: Codex coordinator and two independent read-only scope reviewers; separate completeness/skeptic phase

snapshot.workingTree: Pre-existing dirty main tree; fresh fetch confirms HEAD and origin/main equal with 0/0 divergence. Source fingerprint, not base commit alone, identifies reviewed bytes. No product edit, reset, restore, commit or push during AUD-032.
snapshot.fingerprintFormat: SHA256(sorted SHA256 + two spaces + repository-relative path + LF); docs/audits excluded
snapshot.deltaMeaning: 17 existing changed paths plus one added path; no native Rust changes since that candidate. Current source exactly equals accepted AUD-030/AUD-031. No author attribution from dirty status.

scope.mode: Audit only; production, fixtures, dependencies, workflows and old reports preserved. Only new AUD-032 report/index/public audit helpers written.
scope.coverageMethod: Mixed fresh/composed/exact-retained semantic or structured evidence per file. No hash-only inference of correctness.

guarantees.name: Cryptographic profiles
guarantees.assessment: No native/cipher/Cargo byte changes from AUD031, no weakening of12rounds, Argon2cost, lanes, passwordNFKD, suite/domain constants or canonical bit encodings found.

guarantees.name: Bounded raw/domain inputs
guarantees.assessment: Rawphrase/card/review guards remain; hints/wishes gaps and CLI passphrase prompt gaps prevent blanket compliance. Normalized cipherpassword1024 and rawpassphrase1024 are separate.

guarantees.name: Secret owners
guarantees.assessment: LockedText/Bytes keep allocation identity and wipe capacity before pageguard release. SecretJSON uses borrowed views/exactsize wipingbuffer. No allregister/stack/GC/OS erasure claim.

guarantees.name: Recovery/rekey correctness
guarantees.assessment: Confirmation/origin/explicit owner/passed reference constraints retain exact-source review. Raw endedcredentials optional lifetime caveat and actualnativeplatform execution remain.

guarantees.name: Known-answer meaning
guarantees.assessment: Full vectors are finite2operation/witnessedround evidence, not universal correctness. CLI header still overstates; requestonly fullwork unchanged.

browserImpactProfiles.browser-api: Fresh lifecycle, public declarations, encoder, options, startup/cache/failure, request framing and supported typed-array paths traced; native semantics independently challenged. Existing startup/worker ownership mostly sound but incomplete final-report candidate is new.
browserImpactProfiles.browser-harness: Changed literal values, actual class registration, worker counters, wish getter tripwires and option shapes reviewed against production. Exact retained callers maintain real DOM/Blob-worker paths; no current scheduling/visual run by reviewer.
browserImpactProfiles.package-controls: New invalid-container/oversized-count regressions use external worker seam, real bindings and literal code/messages. Existing1/64/256MiB controls and composed negative cases retained; missing hint/single-entry/report completeness controls identified.
browserImpactProfiles.terminal-controls: Unchanged terminal harness context retained, no native input/menu verdict adopted blindly. Root/native own actual new PTY controls; request-only fullsize tests are separate.
browserImpactProfiles.independent-checkers: Exact source/fixture context retained at prior declared depth. Historical independent crypto checker identity and vector evidence remain finite and dated; no current fullcost computation or downloaded upstream review.
browserImpactProfiles.packaging: Fresh ZIP writer stages new same-directory temporary archive then renames; conditional failure paths and stale-member removal agree with controls. Source remapping/Cargo-output/pinned canonical build boundaries retained; no cached/uncached or native package certification.
browserImpactProfiles.ci: Fresh whole workflow reads show SHA-pinned actions, top-level read permissions, raised publish permissions, superseded-run cancellation and fast-only push triggers. No AI-agent-integration workflow or issue write added.
browserImpactProfiles.remaining-gates-config: Exact source/declarative context retained with current source-assembly, CLI checker, network, provenance and fast-command callers; automatic gates remain scoped detectors, not proof all CORE rules hold.

findings.title: Word-hint requests have no raw utility byte admission
findings.expected: An outside utility request has an explicit size bound; reuse the existing InputText domain, preserving normal last-word behavior. This is a coding-rule bound, not an altered cryptographic-format requirement.
findings.observed: Both actual raw bindings and public classes accept 8,193 UTF-8 bytes for both BIP39/EFF hint lists. 8,192-byte ASCII/multibyte positives and literal dictionary/completion controls pass. Class transport includes the full payload.
findings.impact: Avoidable linear scanning and copied/transferred data before a small answer; no measured exhaustion, remote attack or secret leak. Native typed-line front ends already cap their input; raw/browser callers expose this gap.
findings.recommendedFix: Settle the public hint input contract and use library-owned admission in the raw binding and pre-encode class paths; expose/reuse needed metadata. Do not silently truncate text or alter KDF parameters. Preserve typed: MhfeSecret, including Uint8Array; the current string-only InputTextBoundary.read is insufficient for that public contract. Passwords metadata needs the selected utility-limit contract.
findings.requiredVerification: Exact max/max+1 byte controls with multibyte input; normal hints/completions; stable error code; pre-copy/worker ordering; document any source API signature/limit changes.

findings.title: Invalid UTF-8 in an interactive visible answer bypasses retry
findings.expected: Explain the invalid interactive answer and ask the same field again, preserving preceding answers. Real I/O failure and cancellation remain failures/stops.
findings.observed: The actual fingerprint prompt retries an ordinary malformed answer, then an invalid UTF-8 byte exits 2 before recovery. Source review finds the same fatal propagation for an excessive visible answer beyond ANSWER_BYTES (8,190); that variant was not newly executed.
findings.impact: Recoverable interactive input loses prior state. Script fail-fast behavior is not alleged to be wrong; hidden secret input has a separate retry loop.
findings.recommendedFix: Handle the existing typed invalid-input refusal at the interactive visible-input seam and drain only the refused line; do not swallow cancellation or genuine I/O errors.

Include excessive visible-line retry and full refused-line draining; preserve genuine I/O, EOF/cancel and script-mode semantics.

findings.title: An excessive interactive BIP39 passphrase is refused only after its prompt

findings.impact: Late recoverable input refusal loses prior interactive state. This is not the historical too-late-KDF variant: the native domain guard correctly prevents Argon2 rounds.

findings.title: Incomplete final startup reports can admit an operation
findings.releaseBlockingReason: The normal trusted current Rust producer emits a complete report; no spontaneous producer omission or attacker path without package-code control was demonstrated. This is a malformed-protocol resilience defect.
findings.expected: A fresh class with no cached passes must reject a partial/mismatched final startup report before starting its actual requested operation. Legitimate cached/tier-filtered and explicit failed-trap reports remain valid.
findings.observed: After a complete actual five-component report succeeds, each of three fresh module identities receives an incomplete final report: empty components without ids, empty components with all actual startup ids, and the first component with all ids. All three dispatch the actual class inspectContainer request and resolve from a synthetic stand-in-worker operation response. The real Rust inspectContainer computation is not executed by this probe. The strict assertion exits 1.
findings.impact: A malformed final response can turn absent self-check evidence into page-only success. No failing cryptographic result, ordinary-producer omission, remote exploit or compromise was established.
findings.recommendedFix: Validate required completed tier/component identity and multiplicity before updating shared passed-check state or admitting the operation. Do not use every([]) or silently remove required absent ids as success.
findings.requiredVerification: Fresh empty/partial/missing-id/extra-id/duplicate/mismatched reports refuse before operation and do not poison cache; retain complete real positives, shared verified-cache skip, startup/full tier differences and failed trap reports without ids. Native set.ids() includes full-only items before tier filtering, so requiring every declared id at startup is incorrect.

findings.title: The ordinary PTY cancellation control assumes text survives a combined Ctrl+C write
findings.releaseBlockingReason: A required ordinary Unix terminal gate currently fails on this Linux host. This is a test-driver prerequisite failure; native macOS execution is not claimed.
findings.expected: Establish that the fixture was visibly rendered before checking private display/erasure and cancellation. Keep strict non-vacuous assertions and the expected cancellation status/terminal restoration.
findings.observed: The driver sends SECRET plus Ctrl+C in one write. Unix ISIG/default flushing may discard unread text before the application displays it. After 15 earlier printed scenario summaries, the ordinary group exits 1 with AssertionError: Ctrl+C: the expected password was not shown. The earlier cancellation status 130 and terminal-settings assertions pass.
findings.impact: The required gate cannot currently establish its cancellation/concealment assertion and blocks acceptance. No secret echo/leak or product cancellation failure was demonstrated.
findings.recommendedFix: Send synthetic text separately, synchronize on its rendered private-screen fixture, then send Ctrl+C and retain the current strict oracle. Do not weaken the assertion or disable Python assertions.
findings.requiredVerification: A real Unix PTY demonstrates the fixture first and passes Ctrl+C status, private display, erasure and terminal restoration. Include a repeated/race control; verify the applicable native platform separately. The audit wrapper must refuse Python -O before spawning.
findings.history: The earlier strict-oracle correction under AUD-028-BLD006 remains valid; it exposed this distinct driver timing/precondition defect.
